snippet.title: Trailer Darkray 4K
snippet.description:
Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4358430/DarkRay/?curator_clanid=46171584
About this game
The city turned to ashes. The streets were empty. But underground — in ramified catacombs, flooded tunnels and abandoned bunkers — life goes on. An ugly, aggressive and deadly life.

You are an ordinary cat, thrown into the very epicenter of the disaster. There is no way up. Radiation, landslides and darkness have cut off all exits. The only chance to survive is to go deeper and find another way out.

But you are not alone there.

A huge underground world

Explore a multi-level maze of catacombs, sewers, abandoned bunkers and flooded tunnels. Each zone has its own atmosphere, its own dangers and its own secrets. Some passages are hidden. Some are intentionally walled up. And it is not always clear whether this is happening from the outside or from the inside.

Stealth and escape


Mutant rats patrol the corridors. Huge spiders are weaving traps in dark corners. They're not just dangerous, they're smart. Use your cat's natural agility and instincts: hide in the shadows, distract enemies with sound, and squeeze through gaps inaccessible to anyone but you. Sometimes the best way out is not to fight, but to disappear. But if you get noticed, run. Quickly.

Dungeon Puzzles


Old mechanisms, blocked airlocks, collapsed ceilings and mysterious symbols on the walls of bunkers — the underground world is full of obstacles that cannot be overcome by force. Think, observe, experiment. Some puzzles hide the shortest path. Others are what it was better not to find.

An atmosphere without words


Without text. Without dialogues. Just you, the darkness, and the sounds of the dungeon. The story is told through the environment — graffiti on the walls, abandoned things, traces of those who were here before you. The world speaks for itself. You just need to learn how to listen to him.


Nine lives. One way out. Endless darkness.
